request_summary: Coordinate the requested GEC test and ACE trace commit with explicitly confirmed scope and unresolved test failure.

actions.description: Checked branch and index; previously staged deletions were resolved by the user in a separate commit. Obtained explicit confirmation of the partial-work scope despite the failed scenario.
Assigned local commit-only closure to QA-closer and verified the resulting commit's subject, trailer and exact ten paths.
actions.tool: QA-closer delegation, git log and git diff-tree

outcome.detail: The confirmed scope was committed locally without push or PR; the disclosed GEC failure remains unresolved.

friction.description: An initially staged pair of unrelated deletions blocked the commit until the user separately committed them.
An incorrect ACE script name and an unsupported help invocation failed; the script was located and its invocation inspected before successful manifest preparation.
